column1: # Compile-time limits are baseline measurements plus explicit headroom.
# Measurements use Linux ARM, except delegation, alternating, receive_cycles, global_capacity and orchestration:
# macOS ARM targeting thumbv6m-none-eabi. Orchestration memory uses the 415 MiB
# aggregate guard peak across both builds as a conservative bound for each case.
# These are build regression limits, not runtime capacities.
